job.title: Distribution Centre Operations Manager
job.description:
WSR is recruiting for an experienced UK & European Distribution Centre Operations Manager on behalf of an established international client.

Location: UK preferred; European - based candidates considered
Salary: £55,000 - £60,000 per annum for UK-based candidates, depending on experience
Travel: Up to 50% across the UK and Continental Europe
Proposed start date: January 2027

Fluent business-level German and English are essential.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to lead warehouse and distribution operations across the UK and Continental Europe, with an immediate focus on the setup, launch and stabilisation of two new distribution centres.

Reporting to the Group Operations Director, you will oversee warehouse performance, inventory accuracy, customer fulfilment and transport services. Working with internal teams, third-party logistics providers and carriers, you will establish consistent operating standards and deliver improvements in service, productivity and cost.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead operational performance across UK and European distribution centres, covering goods receipt, storage, picking, packing, dispatch and returns.
  • Manage the operational setup and successful launch of new facilities, ensuring a smooth transition into day-to-day operations.
  • Plan warehouse capacity, staffing and resources to meet forecasts, project requirements and business growth.
  • Manage 3PL and transport partners through service reviews, contractual KPIs and improvement plans.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counting, stock audits, reconciliation and effective stock adjustment controls.
  • Investigate discrepancies, picking errors, damage and losses, implementing corrective actions.
  • Coordinate stock transfers between locations and manage slow-moving, obsolete and excess stock with relevant teams.
  • Monitor delivery performance, lead times, freight costs and service issues, working with Sales and Customer Service to resolve problems.
  • Develop operational dashboards covering safety, service, quality, inventory, productivity, cost and capacity.
  • Improve warehouse processes, space utilisation and cost efficiency, identifying opportunities for automation where appropriate.
  • Maintain operating procedures, support audits and ensure compliance with applicable health, safety and quality requirements.
  • Lead, coach and develop operational teams while building effective relationships across the business.

About You

You will be an organised and commercially aware operations leader who combines practical warehouse knowledge with strong analytical and people management skills.

Essential experience and skills:

  • At least five years’ progressive experience in warehouse, distribution, logistics or operations management.
  • Proven responsibility for warehouse performance, inventory control and customer fulfilment.
  • Experience managing 3PL partners, transport providers and formal service-level reviews.
  • Experience leading a warehouse launch, relocation, transition or significant operational change.
  • Strong analytical skills, including KPI reporting, cost analysis and root-cause investigation.
  • Confident leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of ERP, warehouse management and operational reporting systems.
  • Fluent business-level German and English.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly across UK and European locations, up to 50% of the time.

Desirable:

  • A relevant qualification in Supply Chain, Logistics or Operations Management.
  • Lean, Six Sigma or equivalent practical continuous improvement experience.
  • Experience within an international manufacturing, project-led or B2B distribution environment.
  • Knowledge of warehouse automation, systems implementation or transport network optimisation.

Why Apply?

You will take ownership of operations across two regions and play a central role in launching new distribution facilities. This position offers the opportunity to shape processes, develop teams and deliver measurable improvements across an international logistics network.

job.title: Health & Safety Officer

WSR is recruiting for a Health & Safety Officer / Advisor on behalf of our manufacturing client based in Corby.

Location: Corby
Salary: £40,000 per annum
Working Days: Monday - Friday

The Role

Are you a proactive, hands-on health and safety professional who enjoys engaging with people and making a difference on the shop floor?

Reporting to the Site Manager, you will help strengthen the site’s safety culture and promote high standards of health, safety and environmental performance. You will ideally have:

  • A relevant health and safety qualification, such as the NEBOSH National General Certificate, or equivalent experience and knowledge.
  • Experience within a manufacturing or industrial environment, ideally involving machinery, production equipment and maintenance activities.
  • A sound understanding of UK health and safety legislation, risk assessment and incident investigation.
  • Experience conducting workplace inspections and audits and supporting corrective actions.
  • Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to engage with employees, supervisors and senior management.

job.title: Project Design Manager
job.description:
WSR is recruiting for an experienced Project Design Manager on behalf of an established client based in Sittingbourne.

Project Design Manager - Bespoke Retail Fixtures and Prototype Manufacturing

  • Location: Sittingbourne
  • Salary: £40,000 - £45,000 per annum
  • Job Type: Permanent - on site

The Role

This hands-on development and engineering role will take responsibility for bespoke retail fixtures and prototypes from initial brief through to manufacture, installation and final sign-off. You will coordinate internal production teams, designers, project managers and external suppliers to ensure every project is technically sound, commercially viable and delivered on time, within budget and to the required quality standards.

The successful candidate will combine practical joinery and shopfitting knowledge with strong project management, design-for-manufacture and engineering capabilities. You will act as the technical lead for prototype development while helping the business expand its CNC, 3D-printing and in-house production capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Attend project briefing sessions with Account Management, Project Management and Design teams to establish requirements, milestones and delivery dates.
  • Take ownership of prototype and bespoke fixture projects from concept and material approval through to production, installation and sign-off.
  • Coordinate the model shop, assembly department and external manufacturing partners so that project requirements and expectations are clearly understood.
  • Work with designers and project managers to source, review and approve suitable materials.
  • Prepare cost estimates covering internal labour, materials and subcontracted production.
  • Provide practical engineering support to estimating, design and production teams.
  • Lead the design-for-manufacture process for bespoke retail fixtures and prototypes.
  • Produce technical drawings, compliance packs and supporting data sheets.
  • Manage client, brand and retailer approval processes.
  • Ensure designs are fit for purpose, suitable for the intended retail environment and capable of being manufactured efficiently.
  • Recommend design changes that improve manufacturability, quality, cost or delivery.
  • Identify project risks and advise on appropriate risk assessments and mitigation.
  • Communicate costs, timescales and progress clearly to internal stakeholders throughout each project.
  • Coordinate the purchasing of materials, components and services required for production.
  • Use Smartsheet to maintain project plans, costs, purchase orders and quality-control requirements.
  • Produce detailed in-house production plans with clear milestones and responsibilities.
  • Liaise with and visit external suppliers to support successful project delivery.
  • Monitor internal and outsourced production to ensure components are delivered on time, within budget and to specification.
  • Attend relevant client meetings alongside Account Managers and communicate manufacturing information to key stakeholders.
  • Complete project-close reviews, including lessons learned and final budget summaries.
  • Develop the model shop's CNC capabilities and support the technical development of the CNC operator.
  • Manage the internal prototype presentation area, ensuring equipment is booked, stored and disposed of appropriately.
  • Lead 3D-printing requirements, including estimating costs and lead times, coordinating production and reviewing completed parts.
  • Lead the development of electrical requirements for retail displays, including wiring diagrams and hardware specifications.
  • Ensure finished units comply with relevant regulations and client requirements.
  • Conduct site surveys to capture location-specific requirements and incorporate them into design solutions.
  • Support installation, snagging and on-site resolution when required.
  • Provide ongoing development, manufacturing and engineering support to the in-house production and design teams.

Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrable hands-on experience within an in-house production, model-making, shopfitting or bespoke manufacturing environment.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and practical equipment knowledge.
  • Shopfitting engineering experience, from initial sketches through to detailed SolidWorks drawings.
  • Knowledge of CNC machining and associated production processes.
  • Experience developing prototypes and bespoke retail fixtures.
  • Understanding of design for manufacture, materials, finishing and assembly.
  • Experience producing technical drawings and compliance documentation.
  • On-site installation and final sign-off experience.
  • Ability to prepare estimates and manage project costs, materials and labour.
  • Confidence working with internal teams, customers, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • A proactive, commercially aware approach and the confidence to make decisions.
  • Strong organisation, time management and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage conflicting priorities and deliver within demanding timescales.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • A self-motivated and resourceful approach, with the ability to work under pressure.
  • Computer literacy and basic Excel skills; experience using Smartsheet would be advantageous.

This is an opportunity for an experienced development, engineering or shopfitting professional to take ownership of varied and technically interesting projects. You will play a key role in developing the client's in-house production capabilities while working across prototype development, bespoke manufacture, CNC machining, 3D printing, electrical integration and on-site delivery.

If you have a strong background in bespoke retail fixtures, shopfitting, joinery, model making or prototype manufacturing and enjoy turning creative concepts into practical, high-quality solutions, we would be pleased to hear from you.
